value.title: One Night Sake Cup
value.synopsis: Natsume encounters a pair of youkai who make cups that turn sake delicious. Their power is waning, and they've come to a spring that's said to restore spiritual energy. But the spring is occupied by a monster...

value.title: Party of Fun & Game
value.synopsis: While searching for Nyanko-sensei, Natsume gets invovled in a dangerous game of hide and seek.
